claims.evidence: The witness identifies the items only as generic game consoles; no model or region labels are reported.
The report explicitly states controllers, cables, and internal storage content were not shown.
The warranty seals on the rear of the units were not mentioned in the report.
Thermal performance and port functionality cannot be determined from static photos.
No controllers were shown in the report.
No documentation or receipts were reported by the witness.

risks.risk: Internal hardware failure (Blue Light of Death)
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the main dashboard.
A clip of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: Console is banned from PlayStation Network
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the console successfully logged into a PSN account.

risks.risk: Storage drive health or capacity issues
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage' settings menu.
risks.if_unproven: as having the smallest possible base HDD (500GB) in failing condition.

proof_requests: Photo of the model and serial number sticker on the back/bottom of both consoles.
Video of both consoles powering on and displaying the home screen.
Photos of the included controllers (front and back labels) and cables.
Photo of the warranty seals to verify they haven't been opened.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
response.reason: The witness could not confirm the brand or model of the consoles, and no accessories or functional tests were provided. A specific model identification is required before even a worst-case price can be assigned.
